steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cook beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until crumbly and brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Stir spaghetti sauce into beef. Reduce heat and simmer.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Stir in spaghetti; cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain.
Add spaghetti to meat mixture; mix well. Transfer to a 9x13-inch dish. Top with Cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and cheese is bubbly, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Basic Baked Spaghetti
raw_recipe.description: This easy baked spaghetti casserole recipe is a delicious version of the classic pasta dinner made with beef, red sauce, and thin spaghetti noodles.

review.reviewBody: I made this for a party and it was a big hit. Everyone raved about it. I used 1lb. box of angel hair spaghetti 2 large cans of spaghetti sauce and cheddar and mozzarella mixed cheese on top. This made a 9x13 pan.

I followed the recipe and wish I hadn’t because there was a lot of flavor missing. Here’s how I would amend the recipe: - During browning of beef, add in chopped onion, minced garlic, and salt & pepper - Before you add in pasta sauce, drain the oil from the meat - The pasta sauce you use will make or break the recipe. Make sure to use a flavorful and robust sauce - Instead of cheddar cheese on top, add mozzarella and a little bit of Parmesan. I’ll make it again using the above adjustments and see how it tastes!

I substituted Johnsonville Spicy Italian Sausage Links, removed casings and browned instead of ground beef. This added a lot more flavor and no extra work involved! This is a great quick meal and something I know everyone in the family will enjoy. I baked mine in muffin tins to control serving sizes.

Just made this for my picky teenage daughters and they loved it. I used one box of Barilla protein angel hair pasta boiled for 4 minutes, 1 jar of Bold & Spicy Ragu and half a jar of Traditional Ragu. I browned 1 lb of organic ground beef and added pepper, garlic salt and oregano. Mixed the pasta with the ground beef sauce and added some black olives. Then put a layer of that in the pan, sprinkled 2 cups of colby jack cheese, another layer of pasta mix and topped with 2 cups of mozzerella. Covered with foil and cooked for 25 minutes, took foil off and cooked another 5 minute. It really is delicious and easy to clean up after too. I will make this again. Thanks!

Instead of hamburger, I use 1 lb of sausage, medium size yellow onion, small can of mushrooms. I cook the sausage and when just about done, I add the onions and mushrooms and finish cooking the sausage. The I put it in a medium size bowl along with my chunky style garden sauce and cover it. I cook my spaghetti for 8 minutes, drain, then put it in my casarole pan and mix everything together, add my cheeses and bake uncovered for 40 minutes.. Wife really likes this, she always goes back for seconds. I can eat on this for 2 days, since my wife "won't" eat leftovers.. Sometimes, this is better the second day..
I make my baked spaghetti with mayo ! It serves as the "egg" and fluffs up to a souffle type dish. Also cup of grated parm! Plus all the cheeses you have! But it's the mayo that turns it into MAGIC!

Easy and good......I ike to simmer the sauce with the meat for 1/2 hour...First I like to sauté about half a small onion and 3 cloves of garlic chopped fine. Next, add meat and brown it and then add the sauce and let it simmer. 20 -30 minutes..This is great for a make ahead meal..it is even better the next day and freezes well also...use in quesadilla or taco salad too... I have also used ground turkey...and season it well with taco seasoning... A Keeper...

It was okay. I'm not a big fan of spaghetti, because I ate it sometimes three times a week as a kid. I followed the recipe, but I put mozzarella cheese on top instead of cheddar. I also put minced garlic, onion powder, garlic salt, and natures seasoning in the meat. I Also cooked it at 360 for about 20 or so minutes because every oven is different. My fiancée like it though so I guess I did good.

Yum! I made this without the ground beef and instead topped with leftover meatballs. Cheddar didn't sound appealling, so I used mozzarella cheese on top. I then flash froze the whole thing, vacuum sealed and placed in the freezer for a delicious, simple meal later.

excellent - used reviewer 2's ideas. sweet Italian sausage and a little onion. one cup of cheddar mixed with the sauce. two cups over top. 16 oz jar of spaghetti sauce with about 1 cup more. also made most ahead and put together with just cooked spaghetti to bake together for 30 minutes.

I made as directed & added pepperoni & green chilis. Then topped with mozzerella, cheddar & monterey jack cheese. I like lots of spices so I also added garlic salt, italian seasonig, & lemon pepper. Love it! Will make again!

First time I've made baked spaghetti at home and followed the recipe exactly. I enjoy it at restaurants but this was a little dry. I would suggest adding more sauce (or only use 1/2 pound beef) and I might also choose cheeses with sharper flavors.

Instead of sherred cheese i used veelvea cheese it still turned out wonderful i also added itialian season and minced garlic and chopped onion to my meat i dont use hambuger i use ground turkey because of my lympthaic coltois it still ws delious
My sister makes this and it’s amazing
I Love this recipe. So easy and good. Didn't change a thing

This was tasty, but next time I will use more sauce and less spaghetti. I cooked a pound of spaghetti but only used about 2/3. It was a nice change of pace to top with cheese and bake it.

After stressing about dinner, I searched online. Seeing most with 10-20 ingredients. I just wanted to bake leftover spaghetti. Then saw this! The most concise recipe I've ever read! 😆 I immediately relaxed! Thank you, Wendy!
